tagline: A specialty insurance company providing property and casualty insurance products through data-driven analytics and technology-enabled underwriting.
hero_kpi_rationale: The company's core revenue, growing at a structural 55% CAGR since its founding in 2014, reflects successful expansion into specialized P&C insurance markets and progressive portfolio diversification.

kpis.name: Gross Written Premiums
kpis.explanation: Total amount of insurance premiums underwritten by the company prior to reinsurance deductions.
kpis.description: Gross Written Premiums reached $2.0 billion in 2025, compared to $16.6 million in 2014, representing a 55% compound annual growth rate.

kpis.name: Net Income Growth (CAGR)
kpis.explanation: Compound annual growth rate of net income since 2016, the period during which the company has been profitable.
kpis.description: The company has been profitable since 2016, with a 46% CAGR on net income.

kpis.name: Earthquake Premium Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of earthquake insurance premiums in total Gross Written Premiums, an indicator of portfolio diversification.
kpis.description: In 2025, 28% of Gross Written Premiums came from earthquake insurance, down from 100% in 2014, demonstrating strong product portfolio diversification.
kpis.signal: Successful diversification: earthquake mix decreased from 100% in 2014 to 28% in 2025.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.

kpis.name: Research and Development Spending (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Not applicable for a specialty insurance company; the company invests in proprietary data analytics and technology capabilities.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Investment spending on tangible or intangible assets.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last seven reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $0.876 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net Income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last seven reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net Income of $0.197 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Gross Written Premiums
kpis.explanation: Total amount of insurance premiums underwritten by the company prior to reinsurance deductions.
kpis.description: Strong organic growth since 2014, with a 55% CAGR.
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $2.0 billion in 2025, growing at 55% since inception.

kpis.name: Net Income Growth (CAGR)
kpis.explanation: Compound annual growth rate of net income since 2016.
kpis.description: The company maintains sustained net income growth with a 46% CAGR since 2016.
kpis.signal: Profitability in strong growth since achieving profitability in 2016.

kpis.name: Earthquake Premium Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of earthquake insurance premiums in total Gross Written Premiums.
kpis.description: Significant reduction in earthquake risk concentration through new products (Casualty, Crop, Surety).
kpis.signal: Clear portfolio diversification: reduction from 100% in 2014 to 28% in 2025.
